sn35.132:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahākaccāno avantīsu viharati makkarakaṭe araññakuṭikāyaṃ.
sn35.132:1.2: atha kho lohiccassa brāhmaṇassa sambahulā antevāsikā kaṭṭhahārakā māṇavakā yenāyasmato mahākaccānassa araññakuṭikā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā parito parito kuṭikāya anucaṅkamanti anuvicaranti uccāsaddā mahāsaddā kānici kānici selissakāni karontā
sn35.132:1.3: ime pana muṇḍakā samaṇakā ibbhākiṇhā bandhupādāpaccā, imesaṃ bharatakānaṃ sakkatā garukatā mānitā pūjitā apacināti.
sn35.132:1.4: atha kho āyasmā mahākaccāno vihārā nikkhamitvā te māṇavake etadavoca:
sn35.132:1.7: evaṃ vutte te māṇavakā tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
sn35.132:1.8: atha kho āyasmā mahākaccāno te māṇavake gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi.
sn35.132:3.1: dhamme ca jhāne ca ratā ahesuṃ
sn35.132:8.1: atha kho te māṇavakā kupitā anattamanā yena lohicco brāhmaṇo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā lohiccaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn35.132:8.2: yagghe bhavaṃ jāneyya samaṇo mahākaccāno brāhmaṇānaṃ mante ekaṃsena apavadati paṭikkosatīti.
sn35.132:8.3: evaṃ vutte lohicco brāhmaṇo kupito ahosi anattamano.
sn35.132:8.5: na kho pana metaṃ patirūpaṃ yohaṃ aññadatthu māṇavakānaṃ yevasutvā samaṇaṃ mahākaccānaṃ akkoseyyaṃ paribhāseyyaṃ.
sn35.132:9.1: atha kho lohicco brāhmaṇo tehi māṇavakehi saddhiṃ yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā mahākaccānena saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn35.132:9.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho lohicco brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etadavoca.
sn35.132:9.3: āgamaṃsu nu khvidha bho kaccāna, amhākaṃ sambahulā antevāsikā kaṭṭhahārakā māṇavakāti?
sn35.132:9.4: āgamaṃsu khvidha te brāhmaṇa sambahulā antevāsikā kaṭṭhahārakā māṇavakāti.
sn35.132:9.5: ahu pana bhoto kaccānassa tehi māṇavakehi saddhiṃ koci deva kathāsallāpoti.
sn35.132:9.6: ahu kho me brāhmaṇa tehi māṇavakehi saddhiṃ kocideva kathāsallāpoti.
sn35.132:9.7: yathā kathampana bhoto kaccānassa tehi māṇavakehi saddhiṃ ahosi kathāsallāpoti?
sn35.132:9.8: evaṃ kho me brāhmaṇa tehi māṇavakehi saddhiṃ ahosi kathā sallāpo.
sn35.132:11.1: evaṃ kho me brāhmaṇa tehi māṇavakehi saddhiṃ ahosi kathāsallāpoti:
sn35.132:12.2: kittāvatā nu kho bho kaccāna, aguttadvāro hotīti?
sn35.132:12.3: idha brāhmaṇa ekacco cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe adhimuccati, appiyarūpe rūpe vyāpajjati, anupaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati parittacetaso,
sn35.132:12.4: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā na nirujjhanti.
sn35.132:12.9: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme adhimuccati, appiyarūpe dhamme vyāpajjati anupaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati parittacetaso,
sn35.132:12.10: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
sn35.132:12.12: acchariyaṃ bho kaccāna, abbhutaṃ bho kaccāna,
sn35.132:12.13: yāvañcidaṃ bhotā kaccānena aguttadvārova samāno aguttadvāroti akkhāto
sn35.132:13.2: kittāvatā nu kho bho kaccāna, guttadvāro hotīti?
sn35.132:13.3: idha brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe nādhimuccati, appiyarūpe rūpe na vyāpajjati, upaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso,
sn35.132:13.4: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
sn35.132:13.9: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme nādhimuccati, appiyarūpe dhamme na vyāpajjati upaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso,
sn35.132:13.10: tañca ceto vimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ. yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
sn35.132:14.1: acchariyaṃ bho kaccāna abbhutaṃ bho kaccāna,
sn35.132:14.2: yāvañcidaṃ bhotā kaccānena guttadvārova samāno guttadvāroti akkhāto.
sn35.132:14.3: abhikkantaṃ bho kaccāna abhikkantaṃ bho kaccāna,
sn35.132:14.4: seyyathāpi bho kaccāna, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti: evameva bhotā kaccānena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
sn35.132:14.5: esāhaṃ bho kaccāna, taṃ bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
sn35.132:14.6: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ kaccāno dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gataṃ.
sn35.132:14.7: yathā ca bhavaṃ kaccāno makkarakaṭe upāsakakulāni upasaṅkamati, evameva lohiccakulaṃ upasaṅkamatu.
sn35.132:14.8: tattha ye māṇavakā vā māṇavikā vā bhavantaṃ kaccānaṃ abhivādessanti paccuṭṭhissanti āsanaṃ vā udakaṃ vā dassanti tesaṃ taṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
